verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is a recurring automated full export (Settings > Full Export > Automated Full Export > Add Schedule). That is a real recurring job, but it is limited to backups. The REST API and MCP integration would let an external tool drive scheduled work, but Capacities itself documents no scheduler for that. Missing for 10: native scheduling of user-defined recurring workflows or AI agent runs, a scheduler for recurring tasks or templates beyond export, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
